Project 02

Sales Performance Analysis

Retail Sales Dashboard. An end-to-end sales analysis project focused on transforming raw retail data into meaningful business insights and understanding overall sales performance.

Tools
Excel • Power BI • DAX
Focus
Sales • Profit • Products • Growth

What I did

  1. Cleaned and prepared raw sales data.
  2. Transformed date fields into Year and Month for time-based analysis.
  3. Built Pivot Tables to analyze sales, profit, and top-performing products.
  4. Created key KPIs including Sales, Profit, Profit Margin, and Growth %.
  5. Built an interactive Power BI dashboard with Year and Category slicers.
  6. Performed Year-over-Year growth analysis.

Project 03

Sales Dashboard

Cleaned and modeled 7 raw tables from an electronics retail dataset (9 branches, Egypt) in Power Query, ready for reporting.

Tools
Power Query • Power BI • Data Modeling
Open project on GitHub

Executive Overview

  • Overall Business Performance: Displays key business KPIs, including Net Sales (75.65M), Profit (11.71M), and Profit Margin (15.48%).
  • Sales Trends & Category Analysis: Tracks monthly sales performance and compares sales across product categories to identify trends.
  • Branch Performance & Geographic Insights: Compares sales across branches and visualizes their geographic distribution on a map.

Products & Customers

  • Product Performance: Highlights the top 10 best-selling products and compares sales performance across categories and subcategories.
  • Customer Segmentation: Analyzes unique customers, customer segments, and top customers based on sales, orders, and profit.
  • Sales & Return Analysis: Tracks units sold, average selling price, and return rate to evaluate product performance and sales efficiency.

Branches & Team

  • Target Performance Analysis: Tracks sales performance against monthly targets and measures overall target achievement.
  • Sales Team & Branch Performance: Evaluates sales representatives' performance and compares sales results across different channels.
  • Operational Efficiency Monitoring: Monitors cancellation rates, average delivery days, payment methods, and order fulfillment status.
